name: Pump Motor Assembly PMA-450
description: Close coupled unit. 4 kW drive, 415V, 2880 r/min, discharge 30 m3/hr, 25 bar head, SS304 impeller.
notes: Name contains both 'pump' and 'motor' - classifier must resolve the ambiguity from context.

name: Model 4420-XR
description: Handles up to 1200 gpm at 150 psi. Bronze construction. Driven by a 40 hp prime mover at 1750 rpm.
notes: No product-type word in the name at all; imperial units throughout; 60 Hz speed.

name: Rotary Screw Package, 30 kW
description: Delivers 5.1 m3/h FAD at 7 bar g. Sound pressure 68 dB(A). Integrated dryer. 400 V 3 ph 50 Hz. Dry weight 620 kg.

name: Explosion Proof Motor 5.5kW Ex d IIB T4
description: Flameproof three phase motor, 5.5 kW, 415 V, 1450 rpm, IP66, ATEX and IECEx certified, class H insulation, 78kg.
notes: No space before kg; hazardous-area coding.

name: Butterfly Valve, Wafer Type, 6 inch
description: DN150 wafer butterfly valve. PN10. Ductile iron body with EPDM seat. Suitable to 120 degrees. Handle operated.
notes: Pressure given only as PN class, not in bar; temperature written as 'degrees'.

name: Gear Pump GP-2
description: Positive displacement gear pump. 25 l/min at 20 bar. Cast iron. 1.5kW 1440rpm motor.
notes: 'gear pump' must beat the generic 'pump' signal and avoid the gearbox category.

name: Inline Duct Fan 315mm
description: Mixed flow inline fan, 1500 cubic metres per hour, 120 W, 230V, 2400 RPM, plastic housing, 52 dBA.
notes: Flow written in words, not symbols - a genuine miss is expected here.

name: Thermal Overload Relay 9-13A
description: Adjustable overload relay for motor protection, current range 9 to 13 A, 690 V max, DIN rail, IP20, trip class 10.
notes: Range values - extractor must pick a defensible single figure.

name: SS316 Sanitary Centrifugal Pump 2HP
description: For food and pharma. 10 m3/h, 3 bar, 316 stainless, 2 HP, 2900 rpm, tri-clamp DN50 connections, CE.
notes: Material written as 'SS316' with no space, then '316 stainless' later.

name: Coupling, Jaw Type, L100
description: Flexible jaw coupling with NBR spider element. Bore 28 mm. Transmits 120 Nm. Max 4500 rpm. Aluminium hubs.
notes: 'coupling' is a weak signal only; bearing category also matches 'bore'.

name: Digital Pressure Switch DPS-100
description: Electronic pressure switch, 0 to 10 bar, 24 VDC, 4-20 mA and relay output, IP65, stainless diaphragm, -20 to 80 C.
notes: Negative temperature in a range; 4-20 mA could be mistaken for a current rating.

name: Cable Gland Brass M25
description: Double compression brass cable gland, M25 thread, IP68, suitable for armoured cable, temperature -40 to 100 C.

name: Vertical Multistage Pump, 5 stage
description: Head 85 metres. Flow 8 cubic m/h. Motor 3 kW at 415 volts. Stainless steel 304 chamber stack.
notes: Head in metres of water column, not bar - a correct system should NOT report it as pressure.

name: Roller Chain 12B-1, 5 metre box
description: British standard roller chain, pitch 19.05 mm, breaking load 18.2 kN, carbon steel, 5 m length, 4.5 kg.
notes: kN is a force unit not in the table; must be ignored rather than misread.

name: PLC Expansion Module SM1223
description: Digital I/O module, 16 inputs 16 outputs, 24V DC, consumption 0.35A, rail mounted, IP20, operating range 0 to 55 degrees C.
notes: I/O counts must not be mistaken for specifications.
